mapper.insert:
SELECT LESSONS_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO LESSONS ( ID, STUDENT_ID, LESSON_AT ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{studentId}, #{lessonAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT L.ID, L.STUDENT_ID AS "studentId", L.LESSON_AT AS "lessonAt", L.STATUS, L.STATUS_MEMO AS "statusMemo", L.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" FROM LESSONS L INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID WHERE L.ID = #{id} AND S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId}

SELECT L.ID, L.STUDENT_ID AS "studentId", L.LESSON_AT AS "lessonAt", L.STATUS, L.STATUS_MEMO AS "statusMemo", L.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" FROM LESSONS L INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID WHERE L.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId} ORDER BY L.LESSON_AT ASC, L.ID ASC
